status: selected compatibility surface compiled and contract-validated; full editor acceptance tracked separately
ownership: Authored compatibility sources outside mps; no IntelliJ binaries linked
api_reference: Pinned MPS Java call sites; selected public signatures and enum values cross-checked against locally installed MPS 2025.3 IntelliJ jars

contracts.implementation: Injected services, reverse disposal tree, dependent reads during cleanup, failure aggregation
Typed registered publisher factories, synchronous delivery, hierarchical topic propagation, disconnected disposable connections
Nested command frames, grouped history, replay suppression, reverse undo, forward redo, invalidation on playback failure or clearHistory
Deferred cached snapshots, parent inheritance, explicit null masking, cyclic dependency detection
WebAWT clipboard and bounded identity-preserving transferable history, custom MPS node flavors retained
Queued Swing event-thread execution, cancellation after posting, bounded periodic scheduling, exceptional completion on periodic failure
Measured completion fragments with decorations/accessibility, status text, focus adapters, content panels, lightweight popup disposal
Identity keys, ranges, XML/HTML escaping, immutable HTML construction, text and font values

limitations: Only selected IntelliJ members are implemented; metadata annotations do not activate IDE services.
No IntelliJ project/plugin discovery, persistent settings, native process control, or native window management.
Browser execution is cooperative; pooled execution does not create parallel browser workers.
Blocking confirmations and reflective bean copy throw UnsupportedOperationException.
Two-stroke custom keyboard shortcuts require host dispatch and currently throw.
Popup decoration/desktop placement flags are compatibility hints; popup parity is limited to the browser profile.
System clipboard means the WebAWT application clipboard; OS clipboard integration is a separate host concern.
Symbolic IntelliJ icon artwork is a visible placeholder until the host registers an asset.

verification.j2cl_surface: Java transpilation and development/optimized Closure bundles passed
verification.browser_contracts: passed: 147 synchronous assertions plus asynchronous scheduler contracts in development/optimized bundles across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit

limitations: Lexical inventory, not Java symbol or overload resolution
Resolved provider means the owning top-level source exists; a nested type or member may still be missing
Instance-member calls and implicit static imports require javac/J2CL for full validation
Wildcard imports and complex inheritance are recorded but not expanded
Subclass-qualified references are a conservative superset and may name members declared by the MPS subclass
Class-name strings are evidence only, not assumed executable reflective loads
